about.intro: I'm Subhasish Dev Adhikary, a self-taught AI & Web Application Developer from Jateswar, Falakata, West Bengal, India.
about.paragraph1: As a college student with a deep passion for technology, I've been teaching myself software development through hands-on project building and constant experimentation. My journey started with curiosity about how digital products work, and it has evolved into a focused pursuit of creating practical, real-world applications.
about.paragraph2: I'm particularly interested in AI-powered applications, modern web development, workflow automation, and building interactive user experiences. I believe in learning by doing — every project I build teaches me something new and pushes my skills further.
about.paragraph3: Currently, I'm exploring the intersection of artificial intelligence and web technologies, working on personal projects that solve real problems, and continuously expanding my technical toolkit. I'm especially excited about SaaS development, API integrations, and 3D web experiences.
